title: Questions 165-167 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
IMPORTANT NOTICE: Planned System Maintenance

Cityline Transit is committed to offering the fastest and most dependable fare service in the region. We have therefore scheduled a major system upgrade to add stronger fraud protection and to shorten card top-up processing times considerably. This will take place from Sunday, April 14, at 10:00 P.M. to Monday, April 15, at 4:00 A.M.

During this window, access to our online account portal and mobile app will be suspended. As a result, riders will be unable to sign in, add value to a card, or use other digital services such as trip history downloads. If you complete any top-ups through our Web site or mobile app just before the upgrade starts, we advise keeping the receipts as a precaution. Please note that fare cards already loaded with value will work as usual while the upgrade is under way, meaning riders can tap through gates and board buses as normal.

If you meet any technical trouble after the system returns, or if you have urgent questions during the outage, please call our rider support line at 555-0417.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your patience while we improve our service.
